events.trigger: Buyer clicks or submits a Cedros Pay checkout action before provider/database writes.
events.privacy: Public event; do not include customer identifiers, email, wallet address, cart contents, tokens, or exact amount.
events.stagingVerification: Bound to host analytics seam; verify one redacted event count appears for the event id.

events.trigger: Wasm checkout, subscription, or credits flow finishes with a successful payment state.

amount_cents.description: Operator-aggregate gross amount in minor units. Admin-scope subscribers only.

route_path.description: Optional attribution; elided server-side when site fails the minAttributionTxnCount threshold (default 5).

product_id.description: Optional attribution; elided server-side when site fails the minAttributionTxnCount threshold (default 5).

idempotency_key.description: Optional Pay-generated, PII-free deterministic identifier for deduplicating this analytics delivery.

events.privacy: Operator-aggregate event. Exact amount_cents and currency are emitted only to admin-scoped subscribers (e.g. cedros-pay:balance-read). Buyer identifiers, provider ids, payment method details, and email are never included. route_path/product_id attribution is elided server-side when txn_count for the bucket falls below min_attribution_txn_count.
events.stagingVerification: Bound to host analytics seam; verify admin subscribers see amount_cents/currency and authenticated subscribers see only payment_rail/flow/occurred_at.

events.trigger: Pay has verified, recorded, and reconciled a checkout; Pay may call granted Balance routes only after this settlement point.
events.privacy: Trusted settlement event for host observability and route orchestration. Safe Pay-owned references only; no provider ids, wallet addresses, raw tokens, emails, or user ids.
events.stagingVerification: Deliver duplicate settlement callbacks and duplicate Balance credit calls with the same idempotency key; verify Balance credits once.

events.trigger: Wasm payment flow fails validation, permission, provider, or downstream processing.

amount_cents.description: Attempt amount in minor units when known; 0 only when the provider rejected before amount resolution.

route_path.description: Optional attribution; elided server-side when site fails the minAttributionTxnCount threshold (default 5).

product_id.description: Optional attribution; elided server-side when site fails the minAttributionTxnCount threshold (default 5).

idempotency_key.description: Optional Pay-generated, PII-free deterministic identifier for deduplicating this analytics delivery.

events.privacy: Authenticated event; cause codes must be redacted and must not include raw downstream errors. Exact amount_cents and currency are emitted only to admin-scoped subscribers.
events.stagingVerification: Bound to host analytics seam; verify failure counts show redacted cause-code groupings only.

events.trigger: Buyer connects a wallet for an x402 or wallet-based payment flow.
events.privacy: Public event; never include wallet address, signature, chain account id, or provider token.
events.stagingVerification: Bound to host analytics seam; verify event counts without direct wallet identifiers.

events.trigger: Wasm refund flow completes against a prior checkout or subscription invoice and the ledger row is committed.

amount_cents.description: Operator-aggregate refund amount in minor units.

occurred_at.description: Refund settlement timestamp; consumers should bucket by this (cashflow convention), not by the original payment timestamp.

original_occurred_at.description: Timestamp of the original payment-succeeded event, for consumers that need restated-revenue accounting.

route_path.description: Optional attribution; elided server-side when site fails the minAttributionTxnCount threshold (default 5).

product_id.description: Optional attribution; elided server-side when site fails the minAttributionTxnCount threshold (default 5).

idempotency_key.description: Optional Pay-generated, PII-free deterministic identifier for deduplicating this analytics delivery.

events.privacy: Admin-scope event. Operator-aggregate only; no buyer identifiers, provider refund ids, dispute reasons, or refund notes.
events.stagingVerification: Bound to host analytics seam; verify admin subscribers receive amount_cents bucketed by occurred_at (cashflow), and that the event is suppressed for non-admin subscribers.

events.trigger: Pay ingests or records a chargeback against a prior payment.
events.privacy: Admin-scope risk event. Safe Pay reference only; never buyer identifiers, provider chargeback ids, raw dispute reason, evidence, or exact provider payload.
events.stagingVerification: Deliver a chargeback-opened event and verify granted Balance consumers can freeze related credits without provider ids.

events.trigger: Pay completes or records a refund, dispute, chargeback, cancellation, or manual reversal that adjusts a prior payment.
events.privacy: Admin-scope adjustment event. Safe Pay-owned references only; no provider ids, wallet addresses, raw tokens, emails, or user ids.
events.stagingVerification: Deliver duplicate payment-reversed events with the same original Pay reference and verify Balance adjusts once.

events.trigger: Wasm subscription create flow completes and the subscription record is persisted.

price_id.description: Stripe price/plan identifier (catalog id, not a buyer identifier); omitted when unknown.

status.description: Subscription lifecycle status bucket (e.g. active, trialing, incomplete).

idempotency_key.description: Optional Pay-generated, PII-free deterministic identifier for deduplicating this analytics delivery.

events.privacy: Admin-scope subscription-growth signal. Operator-aggregate only; never subscriber identifiers, customer ref, or email. price_id is a catalog/plan id.
events.stagingVerification: Bound to host analytics seam; verify admin subscribers see one subscription-started count per newly created subscription.

events.trigger: Wasm subscription cancel flow completes and the subscription record is updated to a canceling/canceled state.

price_id.description: Stripe price/plan identifier (catalog id, not a buyer identifier); omitted when unknown.

status.description: Subscription lifecycle status bucket at cancellation.

idempotency_key.description: Optional Pay-generated, PII-free deterministic identifier for deduplicating this analytics delivery.

events.privacy: Admin-scope churn signal. Operator-aggregate only; never subscriber identifiers, customer ref, or email.
events.stagingVerification: Bound to host analytics seam; verify admin subscribers see one subscription-canceled count per canceled subscription.

events.trigger: Wasm Stripe webhook ingests a charge.dispute.created or charge.dispute.funds_withdrawn event; not emitted for dispute updates or closures.

idempotency_key.description: Optional Pay-generated, PII-free deterministic identifier for deduplicating this analytics delivery.

events.privacy: Admin-scope risk event. Coarse dispute_kind and amount_bucket only; never buyer identifiers, dispute id, raw dispute reason, evidence, or exact amount.
events.stagingVerification: Bound to host analytics seam; verify admin subscribers see dispute-opened counts bucketed by amount, and that dispute.updated/closed do not emit.
